description: This file contains functions for rendering game elements such as the player, enemies, coins, power-ups, and level tiles in a 2D platformer game. It defines drawing routines that utilize the HTML canvas 2D context to visualize game state components and the overall scene.

methods.name: drawRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, color)
methods.description: A helper function to draw filled rectangles on the canvas with specified color.

methods.name: drawPlayer(ctx, x, y, facing, tick, size)
methods.description: Renders the player character with size, facing direction, and animation based on the game tick.

methods.name: drawEnemy(ctx, x, y, tick)
methods.description: Draws an enemy as a circular head with features such as eyebrows and body.

methods.name: drawCoin(ctx, x, y, tick)
methods.description: Draws a coin with a flickering animation and stroke outline.

methods.name: drawPowerUp(ctx, x, y, type, tick)
methods.description: Renders a power-up mushroom shape at the specified position.

methods.name: drawGame(canvas, gameState, assets)
methods.description: Main export function that renders the entire game scene, including tiles, player, enemies, coins, and power-ups.
